reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Trouble Soothing Toner Pad 90P
reviews.text: Super lightweight and does calm down irritated skin. Overall just perfect for oily skin
reviews.zh: 超輕盈，而且真係可以紓緩受刺激嘅皮膚。整體而言好適合油性肌

reviews.text:
まだ使ってないけどブリングリン大好きなので星4！
使ってみてもっとよかったらコメントを書き換えます
reviews.zh:

用過之後如果覺得更好會返嚟改評價

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Trouble Soothing Toner Pad 90P
reviews.text: I really like this pad cuz it hydrates ur skin so quickly but doesnt make ur skin oily! Only thing is that there is only 90 pads inside🥲
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢塊敷膜，保濕速度快，但又唔會令皮膚油笠笠！唯一可惜係入面只有90塊🥲

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Trouble Soothing Toner Pad 90P
reviews.text: This pads are amazing for calming breakouts and soothing my skin. It feels refreshing, absorbs fast, and helps reduce redness. I love the tea tree and cica combo—it really works! Perfect for sensitive and acne-prone skin. Will buy again!
reviews.zh: 呢款敷膜對紓緩爆瘡同鎮靜皮膚超級有效。用落清爽，吸收得快，亦有助減淡泛紅。好鍾意茶樹同積雪草嘅組合——真係work！敏感肌同容易生暗瘡嘅皮膚啱用。會再回購！

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Trouble Soothing Toner Pad 90P
reviews.text: i love this toner so much it got rid of my closed comedones and my skin is so smooth now!
reviews.zh: 我超級鍾意呢支爽膚水，搞掂咗我嘅閉口粉刺，皮膚依家滑晒！

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Trouble Soothing Toner Pad 90P
reviews.text: These are amazing. By far the best soothing pads I’ve tried. My face looked visibly smoother and brighter and they really helped with redness reduction.
reviews.zh: 舒緩敷膜入面，呢款暫時最好。塊面明顯滑咗同亮咗，泛紅都真係減淡咗。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Trouble Soothing Toner Pad 90P
reviews.text: interesting pad texture, not what i was expecting but it’s nice to use it to cool my face down
reviews.zh: 敷膜質地幾特別，同我預期唔同，但用嚟幫塊面降溫好唔錯。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Trouble Soothing Toner Pad 90P
reviews.text: I like using this in the morning after washing my face. It feels moisturizing at first, and leaves a fresh feeling afterwards. A must for oily and irritated skin!
reviews.zh: 鍾意朝早洗完面之後用。一開始有保濕感，之後皮膚清爽。油性肌同受刺激嘅皮膚必備！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
